THE FIELD GUIDE

Know your ghosts.

DiffWarden runs nine local, line-based pattern checks on added lines in a unified text diff. It doesn’t execute code or understand full data flow.

Where the lantern doesn’t reach

Multi-line expressions, dependencies, removed safeguards, binary files and combined merge diffs need other tools and human review. Comments are skipped except unfinished-work markers. Strings may match patterns. Malformed hunks produce a warning. This is an early review aid, not a security audit.

Diffs, findings and notes remain in memory and are lost on refresh. Reports omit source snippets but include file paths and your notes.
